description:
1.Smooth 750W Powerful Riding Performance
750W high torque brushless motor with top speed locked at 20MPH, matched 7-speed gear system and 55Nm torque, easily handles city roads and 30° slopes for daily commuting and leisure trips.
2.Safe UL2849 Certified Removable Battery
48V 13Ah lithium battery with full BMS protection and UL2849 safety certification. Full charge takes 4-6 hours, supporting 20-35 miles throttle range and 30-60 miles pedal assist range. Detachable design for convenient charging and storage.
3.Comfort Step-Thru Frame Complete Configuration
Low step-through frame suits all adult riders, equipped with dual shock-absorbing suspension, responsive dual disc brakes, real-time LCD display, front headlight and rear passenger seat, balancing comfort and daily practicality.
4.Sturdy & All-Weather Commuter Design
Carbon steel frame holds max 265lbs load, IPX4 waterproof electronic components work normally on rainy days. Built-in electric horn and 24-inch standard tires bring stable, safe urban riding experience for men and women.
5.Safety Notice & 24/7 After-Sales Support
This ebike is for private off-road & recreational use only, wear helmet before riding. Our customer service team is online 24 hours to solve all your issues.
